answers.core: Localization is already a critical component of the engine that is supported out of the box. I believe that it needs a few rounds of QoL to make it easier to use before it becomes second nature to add localization in one's game.
answers.workaround: Right now, I have a tool that takes in a csv and outputs a code file with all the keys as an enum, so it can be sidestepped easily. However, that tool requires clicking a button whenever you want to refresh the keys, which is the downside.

title: Automatically generate class constants to access localization keys without using strings in code
